$comment: IMPLEMENTED CREATOR TASK CONTRACT SUMMARY. Action descriptors remain the executable authority; registration exposure and eager/deferred requirements are Host binding metadata outside descriptor digests.
name: QwenPaw Creator

pawapp.summary: Create an empty Creator workspace or delegate a complete brief-to-video workflow.

action_registrations.purpose: Create and return an empty Creator project only.
Create a project, plan and execute the video workflow, publish the canonical final video, and return the project and artifact.

action_registrations.migration_rule: Existing accepted tasks remain replayable and terminally deliverable; new catalog, describe, grant, and dispatch operations reject this action.

create_video_goal_mapping.normalization: Convert CRLF and CR to LF, strip outer whitespace only, preserve internal whitespace, and apply defaults before hashing or rendering.
create_video_goal_mapping.derived_name: First non-empty brief line normalized to at most 96 characters, followed by '-' and the first 12 hexadecimal characters of sha256(submission_id). Explicit duplicate names fail durably.
create_video_goal_mapping.template:
[creator-video-workflow@1]
Submission: <submission_id>

Brief:
<brief>

User script:
<script, or "Not provided; create a script from the brief.">

Production constraints:
- project_name: <resolved name>
- description: <description, or "Not provided.">
- scenario: <scenario>
- aspect_ratio: <aspect_ratio>
- resolution: <resolution>
- content_type: <content_type, or "Not specified.">
- duration_seconds: <integer, or "Not specified.">
- language: <language>
- completion: publish one final composed video

workflow_policy.atomic_bootstrap: Persist the project, session, conversation, initial goal, initial message, and workflow receipt with their exact durable identities before Agent execution.
workflow_policy.execution_owner: Creator Agent and work-graph runtime; the PawApp adapter observes and resumes but never implements a second planner or media executor.
workflow_policy.setup: LLM readiness is eager and blocks before task creation. Image and video readiness are independently deferred until their earliest actionable stages. Exactly one task-linked setup request may be active.
workflow_policy.approval: Generation approval is an independent typed task input request bound to immutable provider, model, operation, target, candidate count, duration, resolution, aspect ratio, and other billing-relevant arguments.
workflow_policy.canonical_output: Exactly one live non-snapshot narrative timeline must select one non-stale final_video backed by an indexed video file and a DONE compose node with current selections and fingerprint.
workflow_policy.publication: Persist a verified Creator source receipt with distinct graph compose and executor/render fingerprints, bound by the durable dispatch key, separately from a source-bound Host publication intent and ArtifactRef. Success requires the current publication receipt and returns one creator-project ProjectRef plus exactly its Host artifact.
workflow_policy.cancellation: Cancellation before publication intent wins and stops only correlated active work. Once publication intent is durable, reconciliation determines success or proven publication failure; cancellation cannot change the terminal outcome.
workflow_policy.failure: A succeeded Creator run without a canonical source, actionable graph, or explicit recoverable review/repair state fails as no_actionable_work. Multiple live timelines fail with actionable guidance unless explicit recovery can resolve them.

configuration.task_linked_retry: saved is not ready; recheck readiness, then advance setup_attempt and deterministically create or reuse the next request while the same task remains waiting_for_setup
